objective: Replace the degenerate n=31 GGMP cell using only public field and curve algebra.

search_space.derivation: ord_31(2)=5, so T^31-1 has six nontrivial irreducible degree-5 factors

forbidden_inputs: relation yield or solver timing from the final target
primary_metric: number of distinct rational curve points above the 32-element linearised-polynomial kernel
selection_rule: maximize the primary metric; break ties by lower curve_a and then lower factor_index
admission: at least three distinct curve points; otherwise classify the candidate as degenerate before target construction

discovery_run.accounting: fresh process-meter receipt for every candidate, including rejected candidates

successor: Run the selected nondegenerate predicate through native XOR, WDSat, CryptoMiniSat and direct MITM; require source validation plus rational lifting and signed point-sum verification for every SAT model.
claim_boundary: A successful replacement repairs one benchmark cell. It does not establish GGMP scaling, a crossover, novelty, or SOTA.
